entities.name: PCA3
observations: Long noncoding RNA gene whose promoter contains the studied (TAAA)n short tandem repeat polymorphism.
Promoter repeat-length variation was evaluated for prostate-cancer risk in Chinese male cohorts.

entities.name: Prostate cancer
observations: Chinese case-control studies reported increased risk with longer PCA3 promoter (TAAA)n repeat categories.
Independent replication remains uncertain because later studies may derive from the same research program or overlapping samples.

entities.name: PCA3 promoter (TAAA)n
observations: In 186 Chinese prostate-cancer cases and 135 healthy controls, 11 total repeats had OR 1.76 (95% CI 1.07–2.89) and at least 12 repeats had OR 5.28 (95% CI 1.76–15.89), versus at most 10 repeats.
A later Chinese study reported OR 1.74 (95% CI 1.06–2.87) for 11 repeats and OR 5.63 (95% CI 1.85–17.19) for at least 12 repeats, adjusted for sex and age.
A 2014 Chinese report also concluded longer repeats were associated with risk, but its accessible abstract lacked numerical effect estimates.

entities.name: PMID:21655300
observations: PLoS One 2011 Chinese case-control study of PCA3 promoter TAAA repeat polymorphism and prostate-cancer risk; 186 cases and 135 controls.

entities.name: PMID:25445501
observations: Experimental and Molecular Pathology 2014 Chinese study of 120 prostate-cancer and 120 BPH patients; longer PCA3 promoter repeats were reported as associated with risk, but accessible abstract lacked ORs, CIs, and P values.

entities.name: PMID:25975686
observations: Chinese Journal of Oncology 2015 study of 186 prostate-cancer, 141 BPH, and 135 healthy participants; longer PCA3 promoter TAAA repeats were associated with risk after sex and age adjustment.
